description: Sends a message to RZLT's team for the person you are helping; the team replies by email within one working day. Use it when the person wants RZLT to get back to them (the other option is book_call, a 30-minute call). Before calling it, show the person the exact name, email, company and message you will send and get their explicit OK; never send on their behalf without that OK, and never invent their details. The message must be 10 to 2,000 characters, in their words, without links. Returns a confirmation to pass on.

email.description: Their work email, where RZLT will reply.

message.description: What they want RZLT to know, as they approved it. No links.

name: send_message
title: Send RZLT a message
